explanation: Place each value v in the range 1 through n at index v−1. Ignore values outside that range and stop on duplicates. The first index whose value is misplaced gives the smallest missing positive. This rearranges the supplied array.
timeComplexity: O(n) time: each swap places a value in its final slot.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
